method: 3D SIMP topology optimization (parts/picogk-catalog/bionic/topopt.py), then PicoGK smoothing and exact functional features
basis_note: Interfaces and loads are NOT measured. The published 76 mm face, 60 mm ring bore and 46 mm height are kept exact by keep-ins (face shell and skirt from source/bionic_keepins.py, ring and tabs as primitives); ring OD 63 mm, tabs, barbs and skirt are the F0 concept values of source/picogk.json. Face push, pull-out and side loads are assumptions (the engineering screen has no force case; its 20 g axial acceleration on a 75 g cap gives only 15 N). The structure under the face is a load-path concept, to be recomputed once the wheel bore, groove and retention force are measured.
